minutes.headline: Planning Board heard a long public listening session on a recreational marijuana bylaw; no bylaw vote, draft due September.
minutes.summary: The board approved an ANR plan for 492 Cove Road, then held a marijuana bylaw listening session with a staff presentation, town counsel and the police chief taking resident questions. The board expanded the ad hoc open space committee from five to seven members and approved prior hearing minutes. It then took up committee reports and ongoing items before moving to executive session on solar litigation.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board held a long public listening session on a recreational marijuana bylaw, with town counsel and the police chief answering resident questions; no bylaw vote was taken.
The board set a target of September for a draft marijuana bylaw proposal, to be worked on over the summer.
The board voted to expand the ad hoc open space committee from five to seven members, adding a Parks Commissioner and a citizen at large.
The citizen-at-large seat will not be filled until it is advertised, with advertising expected around the 23rd.
The board took up an ANR plan for 492 Cove Road; the vote outcome was not audible in the recording.

why_it_matters: A marijuana bylaw would need a Town Meeting vote, so residents will be asked to decide where, and whether, such businesses may operate in town.
Town costs for police training and enforcement were discussed but are hard to quantify; a host community agreement fee, capped by state law, is the main way the town could recover them.
watch_next: Draft marijuana bylaw proposal, targeted for September.
Planning Board meetings on July 9 and 23; a scenic road hearing is expected on the 23rd.
